name: MODIS cloud droplet number concentration (Nd)
size_as_stated: daily means for the period 2003–2015 and averaged to 1°
access: Cloud droplet number concentration from MODIS is available at online in NetCDF format from the Centre for European Data Analysis (CEDA) (D. Grosvenor & Wood, 2018).

scales.note: MODIS Nd daily mean retrievals averaged onto a 1-degree global grid for 2003–2015.
